title: Lee Data Center — 10 MW Site Investment Case
disclosure: Hypothetical Houston, Texas project. All operating, construction and financing inputs are illustrative portfolio assumptions, not market quotes, lender terms, site feasibility findings or a real development proposal.

sources.title: Turner & Townsend Data Centre Construction Cost Index 2026
sources.application: $13.44 million/MW is the assumed non-land development budget. Site acquisition and enabling costs are added separately. It is not a Midlothian bid or an AI-specific facility quote.

sources.title: Turner & Townsend 2026 methodology
sources.benchmark: Typical benchmark facility is about 60 MW IT load. Land, utility works, site works, active IT equipment and professional fees are excluded.
sources.application: The 10 MW case is smaller and includes land, utility interconnection, engineering and contingency. Customer servers and GPUs are excluded. Benchmark and project scope are not equivalent.

sources.title: CBRE North American Data Center Trends 2025 release, February 26, 2026
sources.benchmark: National average lease rate: $194.95/kW/month. Primary-market vacancy: 1.4%.
sources.application: $225/kW/month is an uncontracted analyst assumption, not a Midlothian comparable. Tenant size, power charges, service level and lease terms differ. No separate power reimbursement is credited.

sources.title: Site utility diligence — analyst assumption
sources.benchmark: Broker listing states water available; it provides no binding electric capacity, tariff, fiber or energization commitment.
sources.application: $0.075/kWh is an unverified allowance, not a Virginia tariff. No Texas electricity benchmark is used for this parcel.

sources.title: Uptime Institute Global Data Center Survey 2025, page 7
sources.application: PUE 1.35 is an unverified design target, better than the survey average. It requires engineering support and should be stressed before investment.

sources.title: PowerStack The Data Center Power Reckoning Has Begun
sources.benchmark: User-supplied industry commentary on power access and delivery risk.
sources.application: Used to frame diligence questions only. No queue duration, microgrid saving or vendor performance claim is embedded in the model.

sources.title: Commonwealth Commercial active parcel listing
sources.benchmark: 16000 Midlothian Turnpike, Midlothian, VA 23113. 28.693 acres; advertised I-2 industrial zoning and water available. Page displays For Sale.
sources.application: Listing checked October 28, 2026. Marketing statements are not independent zoning or utility verification. No broker contact or site control is represented.

sources.title: Broker offering flyer — published asking price
sources.application: Asking price is the acquisition input, not an appraisal or agreed purchase price. Reconfirm availability and price before relying on the case.
